mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies with a temperature of 71 degrees recorded near Verona City Hall, and a waning crescent moon is visible.

The Verona Fire Department is inviting the community to an open house on September 19 from 10 am to 2 pm at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great chance to tour the facility, meet firefighters, and learn about fire safety.
There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and trivia nights at the Mill and the Bogey Factory.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department was contacted by the school district regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student, leading to an arrest.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
